subject: Recap: Novus Health security intake & next steps (SOC 2 Type II + VSQ)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@novushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: Novus Health security intake & next steps (SOC 2 Type II + VSQ)

Hi Jamie / Procurement team —

Thanks for taking time on the call earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we’re aligned: 

What we heard from Novus Health:
- You need confirmation of SOC 2 Type II coverage for the calendar period that will overlap the pilot (ideally bridge letter if full report lagging).
- GDPR/HIPAA considerations: data residency and BAA questions for PHI-handling scopes.
- You’ll start a vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) prior to procurement approvals.

What Redwood will provide / actions we propose:
1) Share our most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter if the report predates your go-live window.
2) Send the VSQ template we use for initial intake (attached). Please complete and return; we can then provide supporting evidence.
3) Invite Novus to our trust portal (secure upload) so you can pull artifacts directly. Portal will host SOC report, policy documents, and evidence exports. Link and instructions below.
4) If HIPAA is in-scope, we can start a BAA conversation and loop Legal.

Proposed timeline:
- Today/Tomorrow: Redwood sends VSQ template + SOC2 report + bridge letter template (attached).
- By Eo-week (your side): completed VSQ returned to us.
- Within 3 business days of receiving VSQ: we’ll upload requested artifacts to the trust portal and flag any follow-up evidence.

Next call: If helpful, let’s schedule a 30-min follow-up next week (compliance + procurement) to walk the VSQ and acceptance criteria.

Attachments: redwood_vsq_v1.xlsx, SOC2-BridgeLetter-Template.pdf

Thanks — happy to clarify anything.

Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

---
Note: If you prefer a portal invite instead of email attachments, we can send the invite link and temporary access token.
From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@novushealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Novus Health security intake & next steps (SOC 2 Type II + VSQ)

Hi Laura —

Appreciate the clear summary. A few quick notes from our side: 
- Please redact any customer-specific identifiers from the SOC2 report where possible before uploading.
- We will need a bridge letter that clearly indicates the covered period and whether any control exceptions were noted.
- GDPR/HIPAA: Novus handles PHI in a subset of products. We’ll need to confirm whether Redwood’s hosting model requires a BAA; I’ll confirm with Legal.

Procurement will kick off the intake form (attached) and return it by Eo-week. We also prefer to use the portal to pull artifacts rather than exchanging PDFs over email.

Two asks for Redwood: 
1) Send the portal invite and a short how-to (screenshot or quick bullet steps).
2) Confirm point of contact in your Compliance team we can loop in for any deep-dive evidence requests (SOC2 control owners).

Thanks,
Jamie
Senior Procurement Manager
Novus Health
jamie.park@novushealth.com

Thanks Jamie — appreciate the turnaround.

Portal invite: I’ve generated a trust portal invitation for Novus Health. You’ll receive a separate email from trust@redwood.ai with a one-time link; link also here for convenience: https://trust.redwoodai.com/portal/novushealth/invite (valid 7 days).

Compliance contact: Please loop in Priya Natarajan (cc’d below) for any SOC2 control-owner questions; she leads our compliance and can coordinate evidence exports. If your Legal wants a BAA draft, we can push a template via DocuSign — let us know.

Attached to this reply: redwood_vsq_v1.xlsx (our preferred intake), and a blank bridge-letter template. We can prefill the bridge letter once you confirm the covered dates you need. 

Redaction: We will provide a redacted copy by default and can also provide a view-only portal pull for team-level detail if Legal requests that. 

Please confirm the point person who will complete the VSQ and whether procurement wants the evidence packaged in a single export or as individual documents on the portal.

Proposed next step: After you return the VSQ, I’ll set a 30-min sync with our Compliance lead to review any high-priority control items.

Best,
